notes.title: WARMA 2023 beta is already available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32927727/e975e4702c2bcbb416c3d69eaf21f7a5d5343e5d.png[/img]

We have completed the testing phase and reached the main branch!
Despite the fact that we have done a lot of work, all the most interesting things are waiting for us, we are starting work on the map, because we want to make it high-quality and beautiful, and we will also add new content to the game every 1-2 weeks, such as cars, tuning parts, clothes, weapons, new events and gradual updating the map.

The main list of changes:

1. Character:
- 1.1 Character controller.
- 1.2 Ability to climb or jump over obstacles.
- 1.3 Ability to climb stairs.
- 1.4 Melee.
- 1.5 Aiming and shooting.
- 1.6 Boarding the car as a driver and passenger.
- 1.7 The ability to throw the player out of the car and motorcycle.
- 1.8 The player floats above and under water.
- 1.9 The system of shelters.
- 1.10 Interaction with objects.
- 1.11 Lifting items into inventory.
- 1.12 Aiming and shooting from a car.
- 1.13 Aiming and shooting from a motorcycle.
- 1.14 Carrying items on a character.
- 1.15 Dynamic physics of falling character.

2. Inventory:
- 2.1 Folding and moving items in inventory.
- 2.2 Separating items.
- 2.3 Throwing items.
- 2.4 Removing and putting clothes on the character.
- 2.5 Transferring weapons from the character to the inventory.

3. Types of vehicles:
- 3.1 Cars.
- 3.2 Motorcycles.
- 3.3 Bicycles.

4. Character Editor:
- 4.1 Changing the color of the character's skin.
- 4.2 Changing the color of the character's eyes.
- 4.3 Changing all parts of the character's body.
- 4.4 Changing the density of the character.

5. Auto tuning.
- 5.1 Complete disassembly and assembly of the car.
- 5.2 Replacement of car body parts.
- 5.3 Replacement of car suspension parts.
- 5.4 Replacement of car engine parts.
- 5.5 Adjustment of car engine parameters.
- 5.6 Setting the parameters of the transmission of the car.
- 5.7 Setting the parameters of the suspension of the car.
- 5.8 Painting the car body.
- 5.9 Tinting the windows of the car.
- 5.10 Painting the wheels of the car.

6. Dynamic deformation of the car.
- 6.1 Deformation of car body parts.
- 6.2 Deformation of car suspension parts.
- 6.3 Deformation of car parts from explosions.
- 6.4 Complete destructibility of the car.
- 6.5 Synchronization of the deformation of the car.
- 6.6 Saving the deformation of the car on the server.

7. Stickers.
- 7.1 Sticker Editor.
- 7.2 Saving personal stickers.
- 7.3 Car sticker stickers.

8. Shops.
- 8.1 Clothing store.
- 8.2 Barber shop.
- 8.3 Car dealership.
- 8.4 Gun shop.
- 8.5 Tuning garage.
- 8.6 Vinyl studio.
- 8.7 Parking.

9. Event system.
- 9.1 Delivery of transport to the player.
- 9.2 Provision of items and weapons to the player.
- 9.3 Delivery of clothing to the player.
- 9.4 Withdrawal of items and weapons to the player.
- 9.5 Removal of player clothing.
- 9.6 Event management server.
- 9.7 Rating of players inside the event.
- 9.8 Accrual of remuneration to the player at the end of the event by the server.
- 9.9 Accrual of experience to the player at the end of the event by the server.

10. Types of weapons.
- 10.1 Edged weapons.
- 10.2 Firearms.
- 10.3 Grenades.
- 10.4 Grenade launcher.

And that's not all there is in the game, we have tested all the systems and continue to work on the game.

With each update we try to make the game better!

notes.title: WARMA 2023 The second stage of testing is open!
notes.content:
Today we launched the second stage of testing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32927727/369ad47568e6b6f69bd06bda69375401be9d9b84.png[/img]

The first stage of testing was successful, during testing we identified technical shortcomings and corrected them. During the first stage, character and data saves were enabled.

At the second stage of testing, we added a new system of complete modification of vehicles, as well as redesigned car damage and physics.

We remind you that you can get to the Test in the Beta tab > alpha - Warma 2023 test.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32927727/b86e8aaa8baf5fc1fe345ccba7d49dcf20d0f0d5.png[/img]

Data about the car is temporarily stored on the server, no fee is charged for the purchase of spare parts, until the third stage of testing. In cases when the car does not start or the suspension of the car does not work properly: check, most likely, you missed some detail or incorrectly configured it.

The third stage of testing will be launched when ready and will include:
1. Sounds of the game.
2. The system of pasting stickers of transport.
3. Car dealership.
4. Garage and parking lots for cars.

After that, we will start working on the content for the game. Thanks to everyone who notified us about the problems that occurred during testing, which accelerated troubleshooting.

If you have any technical problems in the game, write to us, we will try to fix the problem in the game as soon as possible.

notes.title: WARMA 2023 Alpha test is open!

We invite you to take part in our new Alpha-Beta version of WARMA 2023.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32927727/b86e8aaa8baf5fc1fe345ccba7d49dcf20d0f0d5.png[/img]

Pay attention:

1. Currently, saving on the server is disabled.
2. There are no sounds due to the transition to a new sound engine.
3. If you have any problems, please contact us or press F5.

What's new?

We have done an incredibly great job in terms of mechanics and synchronization, but I think we won't tell you anything, you can go into the game yourself and get new impressions!

There is another big step ahead, connected with a new, more detailed customization of the car. And after that, we will already be engaged in content filling, quality and optimization. And we will also create new interesting events for you.

notes.title: WARMA ONLINE 2023
notes.content:
What have we been doing all this time?

The last update came out pretty raw, the reason for that was the transition to our server, thanks to which we had the opportunity to create everything we want.

We've been working on a new controller, animation, and new systems, which you'll see below.

[previewyoutube=8x3V1teUw7Q;full][/previewyoutube]

A new character editor that includes ready-made templates of individual body parts.

[previewyoutube=HDQQe3uWQgs;full][/previewyoutube]

Weapons and a system of shelters.

[previewyoutube=j3yuCT-OkCs;full][/previewyoutube]

Hairstyles and beards.

[previewyoutube=a_1hNquyj-E;full][/previewyoutube]

Inventory.

[previewyoutube=-b00VGTowf4;full][/previewyoutube]

There will also be more varieties of vehicles.

[previewyoutube=nw7uYgM8P_c;full][/previewyoutube]

Water transport and water physics.

[previewyoutube=_Pfiv3hapfk;full][/previewyoutube]

Well, how about without explosions and damage!

[previewyoutube=vkbhkhkp1po;full][/previewyoutube]

Naturally, we have synchronized all this for a long time and conducted tests, we also optimized the traffic consumption between the server and the client, worked out the smoothness and quality of synchronization.

We have done a very large amount of work, and in the coming week we will try to roll out the new version to a separate branch for general testing.

Of course, that's not all! We are working on a unique gameplay and more detailed tuning of the car.

The full release of the update for the main branch will take place after 3 stages:

1. Technical testing. (In a week!).
2. General testing of all systems.
3. Build and exit to the main branch.

We really try, thank you for your support and understanding!

notes.title: Damage system for multiplayer! Alpha 0.3.6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32927727/8f17cbc89364418f5f41a75c825d4c19e8283ee9.png[/img]

We present to your attention the world's first fully synchronized soft body physics for vehicles!
The idea and development of this system began long before Alpha 0.3 was released for testing.

The main goal was to make the physics of soft bodies optimized and easy to integrate!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32927727/1d6e7588e06eed75943858e18f35251523a0e0e0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32927727/eea5195c0a5f83e3e2b15fc7a32a4ca031f693be.png[/img] 

We have written our own soft body physics for multiplayer with vehicle damage data saved on the server! This is a high-performance optimized physics that runs on multithreading!

1. Deformation of the entire vehicle body.
2. Loss of vehicle parts.
3. Breaking the Windows of the vehicle.
4. Loss of the vehicle engine.
5. The loss of the vehicle's wheels.
6. Render scratches in the body (optimized).
7. Fast recovery of the vehicle.
8. Full synchronization and saving of data on the server.
9. Small data packets: 60 sync points per collision.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32927727/13062719c42720a17b1d3593146a7dd6f7df022f.png[/img]

We remind you that to get to the alpha test, you need to select beta versions> alpha test in the tab.
The world map is temporary, downloaded from the hosting to your computer in the cache memory.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32927727/7ff97ddd740e42cd0ef0382d08dda4d0eadc8df1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: ALPHA TEST UPDATE 3.3.5 Phone Talk
notes.content:
We are finishing work on the car dealership system, but first we release another update.
Car dealership is a large system, it includes a large number of subsystems, such as a database, a car dealership and business management system, and much more. And the main thing is the delivery of transport to the player. And that's why we had to develop a mobile phone in the game to install the personal transport management app there.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32927727/23716cf24da1e7a695095347a795302df8491e51.png[/img]
Well, what about a mobile phone without calls?
Yes, we have made a unique mobile communication system in the game. This is not the final version yet, but it already performs its functionality.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32927727/7c5957564894f69b2b13d002cc2ef39f67e9cf6d.png[/img]
From dialing a number to making incoming calls.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32927727/1df50dbbde9ec01edd0058424bd004ba07fe2691.png[/img]
The phone also has its own database, where you can enter the phone numbers of other players.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32927727/3ec8e189b320caffa5025ae77f37c8e749db91d2.png[/img]

This is one of a small part of the total work done. You can say the visual part will be seen by the player. In the next update, we are releasing a car dealership where you can already purchase personal transport.


We remind you that to get to the alpha test, you need to select beta versions> alpha test in the tab.

notes.title: WARMA 0.211 UPDATE!
Update: WARMA 0.2 Beta!!!
WARMA 0.2 Beta coming soon
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32927727/79f1882d0187d3bda8ac0e0cf99b1dff65ea36da.png[/img]

[h1][b]Preparing for the global update for WARMA 0.2 beta![/b][/h1]

After the release of the latest update version 0.1 beta, listening to the opinions of all members of the community WARMA! Our team decided to create a new platform and concept for the game.

To prevent those errors that affected version 0.1 beta, we had to go back to the origins and build the game on new technology!

We are pleased to introduce a new platform WARMA 0.2 beta which will replace the old version of WARMA 0.1 beta in the near future!

* New graphics and gameplay optimization! [each feature in the game goes through hundreds of checks and tests].

* New character clothing system that follows the outline of the character's body.

* Technology Blend Shapes, fully create an image of the character of your choice or likeness.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32927727/f4c6b70fa8ff3b6eea2a2c4d5fd81a3538e8c433.png[/img]

* Over 500 settings of the body and face of a character according to the technology of Blend Shapes.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32927727/7ab9ac8bc546d30e629b9d2929628b4443c1e2cd.png[/img]

* New system of inventory and storage of objects, each item of clothing has its own number of slots and features including weight.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32927727/04c732de9d50ab8ea1a36fe6ae14a99c51c3457e.png[/img]

* Inventory has a system of blocks that allows you to stack objects and items in the order you want.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32927727/267e73b6071289db750e12494c113c9d655b5eb0.png[/img]

* Item crafting system, weapon customization, storage of items in the vehicle as well as in boxes, warehouses and more...

Most of the platform is ready, we read and listen to your every opinion and are very happy that you support our project and participate, send new ideas and Express your opinion!

notes.title: UPDATE 29.06.2018 FRIDAY
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32927727/cd4695e3f7a9a0f54a04be55ee868340f1926e8e.png[/img]
Update 29.06.2018. The first police force.

Attention! This update is running in test mode.
Otsutstvuet lokalizacija of police work, at the moment only Russian language. Within a few days we will translate into all the languages.

The update includes: 

* RP police work.
*Search
*Payment 
*Work function to show a passport and a certificate.
* All real ranks for police from private to General.
* Arrest system 
*Payment for arrest of the offender depends on your make your dreams and violations of detention.
* System of auto-search of violators
* Working lights and siren
* Transport interaction menu
* Connection to the database in the police Department to search for violators
* Police work under cover
*Small update on the map 
*And other small changes

Corrected:

* Fixed missing parts in the garage when the disconcert
*Fixed loss of mouse in the garage
* Fixed mouse cursor at work on construction site

Next Friday we plan to:

* Sale of used transport.
*Used cabin of the transport
* Hacking of transport
*Update on the map
*Begin to develop a large system of clans and gangs.

If you have any suggestions on design elements in-game menu, or something you really want to be added to the game write in our soobshestve https://steamcommunity.com/app/697630/. We will consider and implement your desires.

notes.title: UPDATE 22.06.2018 TODAY IS FRIDAY
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32927727/d0400d78b652dd41a44d7883eb3ddf4aa06a9d9f.png[/img]

Hi friends, today will be a small interruption of the server. It's been a few days since the release and we've been tracking and fixing bugs all this time.

Today's update includes:

* Fixed a bug with 22 wheel diameter in tuning.
* Fixed a bug with the mouse cursor when working.
* Fixed the disconnection when connecting to the server.
* Fixed the appearance of zero errors.
* Improved vehicle management.
* Added Reputation (Reputation will depend on your position in the game).
* Fixed character installation.
* Voice chat is off at the entrance (enable on capslock).
* Minor fixes in the scripts.

At the moment, we are focused on the stability of the server, so today there will be updates related to the server and load testing. 

The next update will include:

* The first map segment will be replaced with a more built-up and optimized one.
* Will be added to the work of the police.
* Passport system.
* Correction of other errors.
* System of notification of violations.

If you have any suggestions for improving the game, leave them on the forum, which we will consider.

Hi friends, today is the day of the game's early access! We have prepared a new update! 

In today's update:

*Added two new profitable works
* Improved synchronization between players
* Fixed connection errors
*Amendments on the physics of the character
* Replaced bags with new and more original ones
* Fixes in garage tuning
* Fixed NONRP bug with handcuffs

We plan in Friday's update to finalize the synchronization of cars to more accurate. I wish a pleasant game and good vpechatlenie!
And do not forget that the game is in early access and does not display the final quality! We will try to improve and improve based on your opinion and delight you with updates!

notes.title: UPDATE 15.06.2018 TODAY IS FRIDAY
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32927727/8d656bccfb9c27b2965d677dd9caae8c9d7b03e4.png[/img]

As you know, to develop the functional role-playing game on a small piece of the card is inconvenient for us as well as for the players receiving participants 
the project WARMA. Therefore, it was decided to make a sketch of the new map for more convenience.

We've been sketching out a new map all this week, and it's been in the update today. This segment of the map is 1/4 of the entire planned map that we will work out in detail.

Weekly we will update this segment of the map in parts making it more qualitative and developed, also new buildings and objects will appear on the map.

Why is it necessary?
Updating the map sections in parts, we will monitor the balance of optimization and quality.

Paralelno we'll begin the development work, the police!
The main features are already in the game such as:
*Detention
*Arrest
*Maintenance
New functionality will include a full-fledged work of the police in the game! The Police work will come out for testing in about 2 weeks.

[h1][b]HI FRIENDS, UPDATE WE PLAN TO RELEASE EVERY FRIDAY AND TODAY'S THE DAY![/b] [/h1]

In this update, we've added more languages, as well as improved the game's graphics and more.

[h1]In addition to Russian and English, 8 more languages are supported:[/h1] 

*French 
*German 
*Chinese 
*Korean 
*Spanish 
*Arabic 
*Polish 
*Japanese

[code]You can select the language you want in the main menu of the game. If you want to make corrections or improve the translation of all files in the open access in the LANG folder.[/code]

[h1]Graphics:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added anti-aliasing 
[*]Added vertical synchronization 
[*]changed image correction 
[*]Optimized rendering
[/list]
[h1]More:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Minor design changes in the main menu 
[*]Fixed exit button
[*]Added icons to the minimap 
[*]Fixed display of icons in the minimap
[/list]
[h1][b]We are also working on a larger update that will be released closer to the release. So don't forget to subscribe so as not to miss the next update.[/b][/h1]
